name: Importance-Driven Volume Rendering with Frustum Cutout
aliases: Importance-Driven Volume Rendering (IDVR) with Frustum Cutout
definition: A view-dependent cutout technique that creates a frustum-shaped void around a Volume of Interest (VOI) to allow detailed examination of internal structures while maintaining correct depth perception and visibility of the VOI from any viewing angle.
summary: Importance-Driven Volume Rendering with Frustum Cutout is a view-dependent technique that creates a frustum-shaped void around a volume of interest to improve internal visibility while maintaining correct depth perception.
